_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ اللّهَ أوحَى إلَيَّ أن تواضَعوا، حتّى لايَفخَرَ أحَدٌ على أحَدٍ، ولا يَبغي أحَدٌ على أحَدٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah revealed unto me that we should be humble, so that nobody shows pride over anybody else, and no one intimidates another.
_source.cited_from: Al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, volume:3, p. 558, number:1

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أهلَكَ الناسَ اثنانِ: خَوفُ الفَقرِ، وطَلَبُ الفَخرِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There are two things that have ruined people: fear of poverty and going after pride.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ضَعْ فَخرَكَ، واحطُطْ كِبرَكَ، واذكُرْ قَبرَكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Let go of your pride, put down your arrogance, and remember your grave.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن صَنَعَ شيئا للمُفاخَرَةِ حَشَرَهُ اللّهُ يَومَ القِيامَةِ أسوَدَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever does something out of vainglory, Allah will resurrect him black on the Day of Judgment.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ مِن أسخَفِ حالاتِ الوُلاةِ عندَ صالِحِ الناسِ، أن يُظَنَّ بِهِم حُبُّ الفَخرِ، ويُوضَعَ أمرُهُم علَى الكِبرِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The worst state of the rulers among righteous people is for them to be assumed to love pride and be regarded as haughty.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما لابنِ آدمَ والفَخرِ؟! أوَّلُهُ نُطفَةٌ، وآخِرُهُ جِيفَةٌ، ولا يَرزُقُ نفسَهُ، ولا يَدفَعُ حَتفَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘What is it with the son of Adam [human being] and pride?! His beginning is a sperm and his end is a carcass. He cannot sustain himself, nor can he repel death.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَجَباً للمُتَكبِّرِ الفَخورِ الذي كانَ بالأمسِ نُطفَةً ثُمّ هُو غَداً جِيفَةٌ!
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘It is surprising to see an arrogant and proud person who yesterday was but a sperm and tomorrow will be but a carcass.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): آفَةُ الحَسَبِ الافتِخارُ والعُجبُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The bane of [noble] lineage is pride of it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لقد كانَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) إذا ذَكَرَ لنفسِهِ فضيلةً قالَ: ولا فَخرَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘When the Prophet (SAWA) would mention a merit of himself, he would say, ‘And with no pride.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ أميرَ المؤمنينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) عادَ صَعصَعةَ بنَ صُوحانَ في مَرَضِهِ، فلمّا قامَ مِن عندِهِ قالَ: يا صَعصَعةُ، لا تَفتَخِرَنَّ على إخوانِكَ بعِيادَتي إيّاكَ واتَّقِ اللّهَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘The Commander of the Faithful [Imam Ali (AS)] visited Saasaaa b. Suhan when he was sick, so when he wanted to leave he stood up and said, ‘O Saasaaa, do not display pride in front of your brothers that I visited you, and fear Allah.

_source.chapter: That Which One Should be Proud Of
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الفَقرُ فَخرِي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Poverty is my pride.

_source.chapter: That Which One Should be Proud Of
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثلاثٌ هُنَّ فَخرُ المؤمنِ وزَينُهُ في الدنيا والآخِرَةِ: الصلاةُ في آخِرِ اللّيلِ، وَيأسُهُ مِمّا في أيدي الناسِ، ووَلايَتُهُ الإمامَ مِن آلِ محمّدٍ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ).
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There are three things that are the pride of a believer and his ornament in this world and the Hereafter: prayer at the end of the night [night vigil], his despair of [possessing] that which others own, and his allegiance to the Imam from the progeny of Muhammad (SAWA).

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يا أبا ذَرٍّ ، إيّاكَ والتَّسويفَ بِأمَلِكَ ، فإنَّكَ بِيَومِكَ ولَستَ بما بَعدَهُ ، فإن يَكُن غَدٌ لكَ فَكُن في الغَدِ كما كُنتَ في اليَومِ، وان لم يَكُن غَدٌ لكَ لَم تَندَمْ على ما فَرَّطتَ في اليَومِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'O Abu Dharr, beware of procrastinating with your [high] hopes, for verily you have today [at your disposal] and have not yet reached tomorrow. When tomorrow comes to you, then be in it as you are in the present; [that way] even if you do not have tomorrow, you will not have regret for all that you neglected today.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ فيما كَتَبَهُ إلى بعضِ أصحابِهِ ـ: فَتَدارَكْ ما بَقِيَ مِن عُمُرِكَ ، ولا تَقُلْ: غَداً وبَعدَ غَدٍ ، فإنّما هَلَكَ مَن كانَ قَبلَكَ بِإقامَتِهِم على الأمانِيِّ والتَّسوِيفِ ، حتّى أتاهُم أمرُ اللّهِ بَغتةً وهُم غافِلونَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in a letter he wrote to one of his companions, 'Seize what you have left of your life, and do not keep [deferring] saying, 'Tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow', for verily those before you were ruined because of their persistent wishful thinking and their procrastination, until suddenly the command of Allah [i.e. death] overtook them while they were heedless.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ مُعاجَلٍ يَسألُ الإنظارَ ، وكُلُّ مُؤَجَّلٍ يَتَعَلَّلُ بِالتَّسوِيفِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He whom death overtakes early calls for more time, and he whose death is deferred continues to put forth excuses with further procrastination.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَكُن مِمَّن يَرجُو الآخِرَةَ بغَيرِ العَمَلِ ، ويُرَجِّي التَّوبَةَ بِطُولِ الأمَلِ ... إن عَرَضَت لَهُ شَهوَةٌ أسلَفَ المَعصِيَةَ وسَوَّفَ التَّوبَةَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Do not be like one who hopes for [bliss in] the Hereafter without performance of good deeds, and delays repentance by holding high hopes [of being forgiven] … when faced with a desire, he is quick to commit a sin but delays the repentance.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في مُناجاتِهِ ـ: وأعِنّي بِالبُكاءِ عَلى نَفسي ، فقد أفنَيتُ بِالتَّسويفِ والآمالِ عُمرِي ، وقَد نَزَلتُ مَنزِلَةَ الآيِسِينَ مِن خَيرِي .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said in his intimate supplication, 'And help me [by allowing me to] weep on account of my self, for indeed I have wasted my life away with procrastination and high hopes, and I have now stooped to the level of those who despair of any good to come.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إيّاكَ والتَّسويفَ ؛ فإنّهُ بَحرٌ يَغرَقُ فيهِ الهَلْكى .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Beware of procrastination for verily it is the sea in which losers drown.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَأخِيرُ التَّوبَةِ اغتِرارٌ ، وطُولُ التَّسويفِ حَيرَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Delaying repentance is an act of self-delusion, and lengthy procrastination is an act of bewilderment.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إنَّ اللّهَ تعالى يُحِبُّ العَبدَ المؤمنَ المُحْتَرِفَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Truly Allah loves the servant who is faithful and engaged in a profession.

_source.arabic: جامع الأخبار عن ابن عبّاس : كانَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) إذا نَظَرَ إلى الرّجُلِ فأعْجَبَهُ ، قالَ : هَل لَهُ حِرْفَةٌ؟ فإنْ قالوا : لا ، قالَ : سَقَطَ مِن عَيْني . قيلَ : وكيفَ ذلكَ يا رسولَ اللّهِ ؟! قالَ : لأنَّ المؤمنَ إذا لَم يَكُن لَهُ حِرْفَةٌ يَعيشُ بدِينهِ.
_source.english: It is narrated in al-Khisal that whenever the Prophet (SAWA) looked at a man who pleased him, he used to ask, ‘Does he have a profession? If they said, ‘No, he would say, ‘He has lost his worth in my eye. They would then ask, ‘O Messenger of Allah! Why is that?! He would reply, ‘Because when the believer has no profession, he subsists off his religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : تَعَرّضوا للتِّجارَةِ ؛ فإنَّ فيها غِنىً لَكُم عَمّا في أيْدي النّاسِ ، وإنَّ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ يُحِبُّ العَبدَ المُحْتَرِفَ الأمينَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Undertake yourselves to trading, for there lies therein your independence from what others possess, and verily Allah, Mighty and Exalted, loves the trustworthy servant who is engaged in a profession.

_source.arabic: عن جَعفرِ بنِ محمّدٍ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) أنّه سألَ بعضَ أصْحابِهِ عَمّا يتَصَرَّفُ فيهِ ، فقال : جُعِلتُ فِداكَ ، إنّي كَفَفْتُ يَدي عنِ التِّجارَةِ . قالَ: لِمَ ذلكَ؟! قالَ: انْتِظاري هذا الأمرَ . قالَ: ذلكَ أعْجَبُ لَكُم ، تَذْهبُ أمْوالُكُم ! لا تَكْفُفْ عنِ التِّجارَةِ والْتمِسْ مِن فَضْلِ اللّهِ ، وَافْتَحْ بابَكَ وابْسُطْ بِساطَكَ واسْتَرْزِقْ رَبَّكَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) once asked one of his companions about his means of income. He said, ‘May I be your ransom. I have given up trading. Imam asked why, and he answered, ‘I am waiting for this rule [i.e. the reign of your government]. Imam said, ‘That is strange from you. Your wealth will perish. Do not abandon trading, and seek out the bounty of Allah. Open your door and exhibit your goods, and seek out the sustenance of your Lord.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إذا رَغِبْتَ في المَكارِمِ فاجْتَنِبِ المَحارِمَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If you wish for noble traits, then avoid the prohibited things.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مِن أحْسَنِ المَكارِمِ تَجَنُّبُ المَحارِمِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘One of the best noble traits is the avoidance of prohibited things.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَو لَم يَنْهَ اللّهُ سُبحانَهُ عَن مَحارِمِهِ لَوجَبَ أنْ يَجْتَنِبَها العاقِلُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Even if Allah, glory be to Him, had not forbidden that which He has prohibited, it would have been mandatory for the one possessing intellect to avoid them [at least].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : العِبادَةُ مَع أكْلِ الحَرامِ كالبِناءِ على الرَّمْلِ ـ وقيلَ : على الماءِ ـ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Worship alongside consumption of the prohibited is like erecting a building on sand—or on water [according to other narrations].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : تَرْكُ لُقْمَةِ حَرامٍ أحَبُّ إلى اللّهِ من صلاةِ ألفَي رَكْعَةٍ تَطَوُّعاً .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Abstaining from eating even one morsel of prohibited food is dearer to Allah than a voluntary prayer of one thousand units.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ الرّجُلَ إذا أصابَ مالاً مِن حَرامٍ لَم يُقْبَلْ مِنهُ حَجُّ ولا عُمْرَةٌ ولا صِلَةُ رَحِمٍ حتّى أنّه يَفْسُدُ فيهِ الفَرْجُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘When a man accumulates wealth from prohibited sources, neither his obligatory pilgrimage (Hajj) nor his voluntary pilgrimage (umra) nor his maintaining kinship will be accepted from him, and it even spoils marriage.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قولهِ عزّوجلّ : «وَ قَدِمْنَا إِلى مَا عَمِلُوا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْناهُ هَبَاءً مَّنثُورًا»ـ : أمَا واللّهِ إنْ كانت أعمالُهُم أشدَّ بَياضاً مِن القُباطيِّ ، ولكنْ كانوا إذا عَرَضَ لهُمُ الحرامُ لم يَدَعوهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), with regards to Allahs verse, “Then We shall attend to the works they have done and then turn them into scattered dust”, said, ‘By Allah, even though their deeds were whiter than Egyptian cotton, when the prohibited presented itself before them they did not leave it.

_source.chapter: The Reward of One Who Has Access to the Prohibited But Abandons It
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن قَدرَ على امرأةٍ أو جاريَةٍ حَراماً فَتَركَها مَخافَةَ اللّهِ حَرَّمَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ علَيهِ النّارَ ، وآمَنَهُ اللّهُ تَعالى مِن الفَزَعِ الأكْبَرِ ، وأدْخَلَهُ اللّهُ الجَنّةَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘He who has unlawful access to enjoy a woman or a maid but leaves her for fear of Allah, He - Mighty and Exalted - will keep him safe from the Fire, preserve him from the Great Terror, and make him enter Paradise.
_source.chapter_ar: ثَوابُ مَن قَدَرَ عَلى حَرامٍ فَتَرَكَهُ

_source.chapter: The Reward of One Who Has Access to the Prohibited But Abandons It
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : لا يَقْدِرُ رَجُلٌ على حَرامٍ ثُمَّ يَدَعُهُ ، لَيس بهِ إلّا مَخافَةُ اللّهِ ، إلّا أبْدَلَهُ اللّهُ في عاجِلِ الدُّنيا قَبْلَ الآخِرَةِ ما هُو خَيرٌ لَهُ مِن ذلكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘No sooner does a man who is able to commit a prohibited act abandon it, only for fear of Allah, than Allah gives him in lieu of it something that is better for him in this present world before the Hereafter.
_source.chapter_ar: ثَوابُ مَن قَدَرَ عَلى حَرامٍ فَتَرَكَهُ

_source.chapter: The Reward of One Who Has Access to the Prohibited But Abandons It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) كانَ يأتي أهلَ الصُّفَّةِ وكانوا ضِيفانَ رسولِ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ، كانوا هاجَروا مِن أهاليهِم وأموالِهِم إلى المَدينَةِ فأسْكَنَهُم رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) صُفَّةَ المَسجِدِ، وهُم أربَعُمِائةِ رجُلٍ [كان]، يُسَلِّمُ علَيهِم بالغدوةِ والعَشِيِّ، فأتاهُم ذاتَ يومٍ فمِنهُم مَن يَخصِفُ نَعلَهُ ، ومِنهُم مَن يَرقَعُ ثَوبَهُ ، ومِنهُم مَن يَتَفلّى ، وكانَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) يَرزُقُهُم مُدّاً مُدّاً مِن تمرٍ في كُلِّ يَومٍ . فقامَ رجُلٌ مِنهُم فقالَ : يا رسولَ اللّهِ ، التَّمرُ الّذي تَرْزُقُنا قَد أحْرَقَ بطُونَنا ! فقالَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : أمَا إنّي لَوِ اسْتَطَعْتُ أنْ اُطْعِمَكُمُ الدُّنيا لَأطعَمْتُكُم ، ولكنْ مَن عاشَ مِنكُم من بَعدي فسَيُغدى علَيهِ بالجِفانِ ويُراحُ علَيهِ بالجِفانِ ، ويَغدو أحَدُكُم في قَميصةٍ ويَروحُ في اُخرى ، وتُنَجِّدونَ بُيوتَكُم كما تُنَجَّدُ الكَعبَةُ . فقامَ رجُلٌ فقالَ : يا رسولَ اللّهِ ، إنّا على ذلكَ الزَّمانِ بالأشْواقِ ! فمَتى هُو ؟! قالَ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : زَمانُكُم هذا خَيرٌ مِن ذلكَ الزّمانِ ، إنَّكُم إنْ مَلأتُم بطُونَكُم مِن الحَلالِ تُوشِكونَ أنْ تَملؤوها مِن الحَرامِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘The Prophet (SAWA) used to visit the people of the ledge [of the mosque], who were his guests and had migrated to Medina without their families and belongings. The Prophet (SAWA) had lodged them on the ledges of the Mosque. They were four hundred men, and he greeted them every morning and every night. One day he came to them while some of them were mending their sandals, some were patching their garments, and some were cleaning their heads from lice. The Prophet (SAWA) used to provide them with half a bushel of dates every day. One of the men stood up and said, ‘O Messenger of Allah! The dates you provide us with have burned our stomachs! The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘If I could feed you the whole world surely I would have done it, but [know that] those among you who will live after me will be brought bowls [of food] in the morning and bowls in the evening, and each of you will have a shirt in the morning and another in the evening, and each of you will adorn your houses with curtains and carpets as the Kaaba is adorned. A man then rose and exclaimed, ‘O Messenger of Allah! We are waiting eagerly for that time. When will it be?! He (SAWA) said, ‘Your time now is better than that time. When you fill your stomachs with the lawful, you might also fill it with the unlawful.
_source.chapter_ar: ثَوابُ مَن قَدَرَ عَلى حَرامٍ فَتَرَكَهُ

_source.chapter: The Importance of the Propagation of Islam
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ألا وَإنّي اُجَدِّدُ القَولَ: ألا فَأقيموا الصَّلاةَ، وَآتوا الزَّكاةَ، وَأمُروا بِالمَعروفِ، وَانهَوا عَنِ المُنكَرِ . ألا وَإنَّ رَأسَ الأمرِ بِالمَعروفِ وَالنَّهيِ عَنِ المُنكَرِ أن تَنتَهوا إلى قَولي، وَتُبَلِّغوهُ مَن لَم يَحضُر، وَتَأمُروهُ بِقَبولِهِ، وَتَنهَوهُ عَن مُخالَفَتِهِ ؛ فَإنَّهُ أمرٌ مِنَ اللّهِ وَمِنّي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I hereby reiterate what I have said: establish the performance of the prayer, pay the alms-tax, enjoin what is good, and forbid evil. Verily the peak of enjoining what is good and forbidding evil is to heed to my words and propagate them to those who are absent; you must command them to accept [my words] and prohibit them from going against them, for they are the commands from Allah, the Exalted, and from me.

_source.chapter: The Importance of the Propagation of Islam
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يا عَليُّ، لأن يَهدي اللّهُ عَلى يَديَكَ رَجُلاً خَيرٌ لَكَ مِمّا طَلَعَت عَليهِ الشَّمسُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘O Ali! When Allah guides a man through you, it is better for you than all that the sun shines on.
_source.cited_from: Al-Mustadrak ala al-Sahihayn, volume:3, p. 691, number:6537

_source.chapter: The Importance of the Propagation of Islam
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): حَبِّبوا اللّهَ إلى عِبادِهِ يُحِبُّكُم اللّهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Render Allah beloved to His servants, and He will love you.

_source.chapter: The Importance of the Propagation of Islam
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أسلَمَ عَلى يَدَيهِ رَجُلٌ وَجَبَت لَهُ الجَنَّةُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever becomes a cause for a mans converting to Islam is guaranteed entry into Paradise.

_source.chapter: The Importance of the Propagation of Islam
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما مِن داعٍ يَدعو إلى هُدىً إلّا كانَ لَهُ مِثلُ أجرِ مَن اتَّبَعَهُ، لا يَنقُصُ ذلِكَ مِن اُجورِهِم شَيئاً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Anyone who calls to what is right will have the same reward as he who follows him, without any decrease in each of their rewards thereof.

_source.chapter: The Importance of the Propagation of Islam
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): خيارُ اُمَّتي مَن دَعا إلى اللّهِ تَعالى، وَحَبَّبَ عِبادَه إلَيهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The elect of my community are those who call to [the path] of Allah, the most High, and render Him beloved to His servants.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Knowledge of the Religion
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ دينَ اللّهِ لَن يَنصُرَهُ إلّا مَن حاطَهُ مِن جَميعِ جَوانِبِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘No one can support [the cause of] the religion of Allah, the Exalted, except for one who is well-versed in all its aspects.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَجِبُ عَلى المُبَلِّغِ - الفقهُ في الدّينِ

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Reliance on the Words of the ahl al-bayt (AS)
_source.arabic: عبدُ السلامِ بن صالح الهَرَوي: سَمعتُ أبا الحسنِ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) يَقولُ: رَحِمَ اللّهُ عَبداً أحيا أمرَنا . فَقُلتُ لَهُ: فَكَيفَ يُحيي أمرَكُم ؟! قالَ: يَتَعَلَّمُ عُلومَنا وَيُعَلِّمُها النّاسَ ؛ فَإنَّ النّاس لَو عَلِموا مَحاسِنَ كَلامِنا لاتَّبَعونا.
_source.english: Abd al-Salam b. Salim al-Harawi said, ‘I heard Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (AS) saying, ‘May Allah have mercy on anyone who revives our cause. I asked, ‘How does he revive your cause? He replied, ‘He learns our sciences and teaches them to the people, for verily if people were to know the goodness in our speech, they would follow us.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Sincerity
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما مِن عَبدٍ يَخطِبُ خُطبَةً إلّا اللّهُ سائِلُهُ عَنها ما أرادَ بِها .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Every single servant who delivers a sermon, Allah, the Exalted, will ask him about it and what he meant by it.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Courage
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): قُل الحَقَّ، وَلا تَأخُذكَ في اللّهِ لَومَةُ لائِمٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Speak the truth, and let no ones blame for obeying Allah affect you.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Courage
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا يَمنَعَنَّ أحَدَكُم رَهبَةُ النّاسِ أن يَقولَ بِحقٍّ إذا رَآهُ أو شَهِدَهُ ؛ فَإنَّهُ لا يُقَرِّبُ مِن أجَلٍ، وَلا يُباعِدُ مِن رِزقٍ أن يَقولَ بِحقٍّ، أو يُذَكِّرَ بِعَظيمٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Let not the fear of people prevent any of you from speaking the truth, when he sees or witnesses it, for telling the truth or reminding [others] of a great consequence will neither hasten death nor delay sustenance.
_source.cited_from: Musnad Ibn Hanbal, volume:4, p. 102, number:11474

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Honesty
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ فيما يُنسَبُ إلَيهِ في مِصباحِ الشَّريعَةِ ـ: أحسَنُ المَواعِظِ ما لا يُجاوِزُ القَولُ حَدَّ الصِّدقِ، وَالفِعلُ حَدَّ الإخلاصِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, in what is attributed to him in The Lantern of the Path: ‘The best advice is that which does not carry the statement beyond the limits of honesty, nor the act the limits of sincerity.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Honesty
_source.arabic: عَمرو بنِ أبي المِقدامِ: قال لي أبو جَعفَرٍ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في أوَّلِ دَخلَةٍ دَخَلتُ عَلَيهِ ـ: تَعَلَّموا الصِّدقَ قَبلَ الحَديثِ.
_source.english: Amr b. Abi Miqdam said, ‘Abu Jafar (AS) said, when I first went to visit him, ‘Learn honesty before speech.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Kindness
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يَسِّروا وَلا تُعَسِّروا، وَسَكِّنوا وَلا تُنَفِّروا .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Ease and do not cause hardship [when propagating], and comfort and do not nauseate.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Kindness
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اُمِرتُ بِمُداراةِ النّاسِ كَما اُمِرتُ بِتَبليغِ الرِّسالَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I have been commanded to be amicable towards people as much as I have been commanded to deliver the Message.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Kindness
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لِعُمر بنِ حَنظَلة ـ: يا عُمَرُ، لا تُحَمِّلوا عَلى شيعَتِنا، وَارفُقوا بِهِم ؛ فَإنَّ النّاسَ لا يَحتَمِلونَ ما تَحمِلونَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq said to Umar b. Hanzala, ‘O Umar! Do not overburden our followers (shia), and be kind to them, for people cannot endure what you can.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Good Advice
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عَليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في ذِكرِ فَضيلَةِ الرَّسولِ الكَريمِ ـ: بَعَثَهُ وَالنّاسُ ضُلاّلٌ في حَيرَةٍ، وَحاطِبونَ في فِتنَةٍ ... فَبالَغَ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) في النَّصيحَةِ، وَمَضى عَلى الطَّريقَةِ، وَدَعا إلى الحِكمَةِ وَالمَوعِظَةِ الحَسَنَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, mentioning the virtue of the honourable Prophet (SAWA), ‘He [Allah] sent him while the people were straying in perplexity, and engaged in corruption… He (SAWA) advised extensively and kept on the [right] path, and called for wisdom and gentle exhortation.

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Coherence of the Heart and the Tongue
_source.arabic: الإمام عليّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في الحِكَمِ المَنسوبَةِ إلَيهِ ـ: الكَلَمَةُ إذا خَرَجَت مِنَ القَلبِ وَقَعَت في القَلبِ، وَإذا خَرَجَت مِنَ اللِسانِ لَم تُجاوِزِ الآذانَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in the sayings attributed to him, ‘When a word comes from the heart, it falls onto the heart; but when it merely comes from the tongue, it will not go farther than the ears.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَجِبُ عَلى المُبَلِّغِز - تَطابُقُ القَلبِ وَاللِسان
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:20, p. 287, number:279

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Preaching Through Action
_source.arabic: الإمام الصادق (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كونوا دُعاةً لِلناسِ بِالخَيرِ بِغَيرِ ألسِنَتِكُم ؛ لِيَرَوا مِنكُم الاجتِهادَ وَالصِّدقَ وَالوَرَعَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Invite people to what is good with other than your tongues, so that they see tenacity, veracity, and piety in you.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَجِبُ عَلى المُبَلِّغِز - التبليغُ بِالعَمَل

_source.chapter: What Is Incumbent Upon The Propagator Of Islam: Preaching Through Action
_source.arabic: الإمام الصادق (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رَحِمَ اللّهُ قَوماً كانوا سِراجاً وَمَناراً ؛ كانوا دُعاةً إلَينا بِأعمالِهِم وَمَجهودِ طاقَتِهِم.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘May Allah have mercy on the people who are a lamp and a beacon. They call to our cause with their actions and the best of their efforts.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَجِبُ عَلى المُبَلِّغِز - التبليغُ بِالعَمَل

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ لأميرِ المُؤمنينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: إنَّ السَّعِيدَ حَقَّ السَّعيدِ مَن أحَبَّكَ وأطاعَكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said to the Commander of the Faithful, Ali (AS), 'Verily the truly prosperous person is the one who loves you and obeys you.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): السَّعيدُ مَن أخلَصَ الطّاعَةَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Prosperous is he who is sincere in his acts of obedience.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَنبَغي لِمَن لم يَكُن عالِما أن يُعَدَّ سَعيداً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'One who is not knowledgeable must not be deemed prosperous.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِعمَلُوا بِالعِلمِ تَسعَدُوا.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Act in accordance with knowledge and you will prosper.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): جالِسِ العُلماءَ تَسعَدْ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Sit in the company of scholars and you will prosper.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): في لُزومِ الحَقِّ تَكونُ السَّعادَةُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Prosperity lies in adhering to the truth.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن حاسَبَ نَفسَهُ سَعِدَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever takes account of himself prospers.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أجهَدَ نَفسَهُ في إصلاحِها سَعِدَ، مَن أهمَلَ نفسَهُ في لَذّاتِها شَقِيَ وبَعُدَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Whoever exerts his soul in a bid to improve himself prospers, and whoever neglects and abandons his soul to its pleasures attracts misfortune and becomes distant [from Allah].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أربَعةٌ مِن سَعادَةِ المَرءِ: الخُلَطاءُ الصّالِحُونَ، والوَلَدُ البارُّ، والمَرأةُ المُؤاتِيَةُ، وأن تَكونَ مَعِيشَتُهُ في بَلَدِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Four things make up a man's prosperity: virtuous friends, a dutiful child, a compatible wife, and having the source of his livelihood in his own town.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خُلُوُّ الصَّدرِ مِنَ الغِلِّ والحَسَدِ مِن سَعادَةِ العَبدِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Having a heart free from rancour and jealousy is part of a man's prosperity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِنَ السَّعادَةِ ، التَّوفيقُ لِصالِحِ الأعمالِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Accomplishment of good deeds constitutes prosperity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ حَقيقَةَ السَّعادةِ أن يُختَمَ لِلمَرءِ عَمَلُهُ بِالسَّعادَةِ ، وإنّ حَقيقَةَ الشَّقاءِ أن يُختَمَ للمَرءِ عَمَلُهُ بِالشَّقاءِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The reality of prosperity is that a man's tasks conclude with success, and the reality of misfortune is that a man's tasks conclude with failure.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عِندَ العَرضِ عَلَى اللّهِ سبحانَهُ تَتَحَقَّقُ السَّعادَةُ مِنَ الشَّقاءِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'At the time of the Great Exposure [of our deeds] in front of Allah [on the Day of Resurrection], prosperity and misfortune will materialize in their distinct realities.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أسعَدُ الناسِ مَن خالَطَ كِرامَ الناسِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The most prosperous of people is the one who mingles with honourable people.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أسعَدُ الناسِ مَن تَرَكَ لَذَّةً فانِيَةً لِلَذَّةٍ باقِيَةٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The most prosperous of people is the one who has abandoned an ephemeral pleasure in exchange for a lasting one.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ أسعَدَ الناسِ في الدنيا مَن عَدَلَ عَمّا يَعرِفُ ضُرَّهُ ، وإنَّ أشقاهُم مَنِ اتَّبَعَ هَواهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Verily the most prosperous of people in this world is the one who turns away from all that which he knows is detrimental to him, and verily the most unfortunate person is he who follows his whims.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أسعَدُ الناسِ مَن عَرَفَ فَضلَنا ، وتَقَرَّبَ إلى اللّهِ بِنا ، وأخلَصَ حُبَّنا ، وعَمِلَ بما إلَيهِ نَدَبنا ، وانتَهى عَمّا عَنهُ نَهَينا ، فذاكَ مِنّا وهُو في دارِ المُقامَةِ مَعَنا.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The most prosperous person is he who acknowledges our virtue, draws near to Allah through us, is sincere in his love for us, acts upon whatever we have recommended, and refrains from all that we have prohibited. He is indeed of us and will be with us in the place of everlasting abode.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أعظَمُ الناسِ سَعادَةً أكثَرُهُم زَهادَةً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The person with the greatest prosperity is the one with the greatest level of abstemiousness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يُقَرِّبُ مِنَ اللّهِ سبحانَهُ إلّا كَثرَةُ السُّجودِ والرُّكوعِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Nothing can bring about proximity to Allah, Glory be to Him, except an abundance of prostration (sujud) and bowing (rukua).

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): السُّجودُ مُنتَهى العِبادَةِ مِن بَني آدَمَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Prostration is the highest degree of worship that man can perform.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا قالَ لَهُ سعيدُ بنُ يسارٍ: أدعُو وأنا راكِعٌ أو ساجِدٌ ؟ ـ: نَعَم اُدْعُ وأنتَ ساجِدٌ ، فإنَّ أقرَبَ ما يَكونُ العَبدُ إلى اللّهِ وهُو ساجِدٌ ، اُدْعُ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ لِدُنياكَ وآخِرَتِكَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was once asked by Saaid b. Yasar whether he should supplicate in the state of prostration or in the state of bowing, to which he replied, 'Supplicate while prostrating for verily the nearest the servant can ever be to Allah is in the state of prostration, so supplicate Allah for your worldly needs as well as for your life in the Hereafter.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا أرَدتَ أن يَحشُرَكَ اللّهُ مَعي فَأطِلِ السُّجودَ بينَ يَدَي اللّهِ الواحِدِ القَهّارِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If you want Allah to raise you [on the Day of Resurrection] with me, then prolong your prostration to Allah the One, the all-Conqueror.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أطِيلُوا السُّجودَ ، فما مِن عَمَلٍ أشَدَّ على إبليسَ مِن أن يَرَى ابنَ آدَمَ ساجِداً ، لأنّهُ اُمِرَ بالسُّجودِ فَعَصى.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Prolong your prostration, for there is no act more agonizing for Iblis [Satan] than to see man in the state of prostration, for he himself was once commanded to prostrate but refused to do so.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ قَوماً أتَوا رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) فقالوا: يا رسولَ اللّهِ، اضمَن لَنا على رَبِّكَ الجَنَّةَ ، فقالَ: على أن تُعِينُونِي بِطُولِ السُّجودِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'A group of people once came to the Prophet (SAWA) saying, 'O Prophet of Allah, ask your Lord to secure us a place in Paradise', to which he replied, 'As long as you assist me with lengthy prostrations.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ عليُّ بنُ الحسينِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ... إذا سَجَدَ لَم يَرفَعْ رَأسَهُ حتّى يَرْفَضَّ عَرَقاً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, 'When Ali b. al-Husayn [i.e. Imam Zayn al-Abidin] (AS) used to go down in prostration, he would not raise his head up again until he was dripping with sweat.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّي لأكرَهُ للرَّجُلِ أن تُرى جَبهَتُهُ جَلحاءَ لَيسَ فيها شيءٌ مِن أثَرِ السُّجودِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'I hate it for a man to have a smooth forehead not having any trace of prostration on it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ لأبِي (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) في مَوضِعِ سُجودِهِ آثارٌ ناتِيةٌ ، وكانَ يَقطَعُها في السَّنَةِ مَرَّتَينِ ، في كُلِّ مَرّةٍ خَمسَ ثَفِناتٍ فَسُمِّيَ ذا الثَّفِناتِ لذلكَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'My father (AS) used to have protruding marks from prostration on his forehead, which he used to cut twice a year, and every time he would do so, he would scrape off five calluses, and came to be nicknamed 'the one with calluses.

_source.chapter: Prostrating on the Earth from Imam Husayn (AS)'s Grave
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): السُّجودُ على تُربَةِ الحُسينِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) يَخرُقُ الحُجُبَ السَّبعَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Prostrating on the earth from al-Husayn (AS)'s grave pierces the seven veils.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَزْم كِياسَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Prudence is sagacity.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن أخَذَ بالحَزمِ اسْتَظْهَرَ ، مَن أضاعَ الحَزمَ تَهوَّرَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who adopts prudence is cautious, and he who lacks prudence is reckless.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَزمُ مِشْكاةُ الظَّنِّ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Prudence is the lamp-niche of suspicion.

_source.chapter: Looking into the Consequences of Matters
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن تَورَّطَ في الاُمورِ بغَيرِ نَظَرٍ في العَواقِبِ فَقد تَعرَّضَ للنَّوائبِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who involves himself in matters without considering the consequences exposes himself to troubles.

_source.chapter: Looking into the Consequences of Matters
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : التَّدْبيرُ قَبلَ العَملِ يُؤْمِنُكَ مِن النَّدَمِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Planning before action will preserve you from regret.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 54, number:204

_source.chapter: Looking into the Consequences of Matters
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أعْقَلُ النّاسِ أنْظَرُهُم في العَواقِبِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most intelligent of people is he who looks further into the consequences.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الظَّفَرُ بالحَزْمِ والجَزْمِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Victory comes through firm resolution and determination.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا خَيرَ في عَزمٍ بلا حَزمٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘There is no good in determination without a firm resolution.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحَزمُ النَّظَرُ في العَواقِبِ ، ومُشاوَرَةُ ذَوي العُقولِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Prudence is careful consideration of the consequences and consultation of people of reason.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أصْلُ الحَزمِ الوُقوفُ عِندَ الشُّبْهَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The essence of prudence is stopping in the face of the dubious.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الطُّمَأنينَةُ قَبلَ الخُبْرَةِ خِلافُ الحَزمِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Feeling certainty and quietude before experience is against prudence.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحازِمُ مَن لَم يَشْغَلْهُ غُرورُ دُنْياهُ عنِ العَمَلِ لاُخْراهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The prudent one is he who is not preoccupied by the delusion of this world from working for his Hereafter.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحازِمُ مَن تَخيَّرَ لخُلَّتِهِ ؛ فإنَّ المَرْءَ يُوزَنُ بخَليلِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The prudent one is he who is selective in his friendships, for man is judged according to his friend.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحازِمُ مَن لا يَشْغَلُهُ النِّعْمَةُ عنِ العَملِ للعاقِبَةِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The prudent one is he whose prosperity does not stop him from working towards the end goal.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الحازِمُ مَن يُؤَخِّرُ العُقوبَةَ في سُلطانِ الغَضَبِ، ويُعَجِّلُ مُكافَأةَ الإحْسانِ اغْتِناماً لفُرْصَةِ الإمْكانِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The prudent one is he who puts off punishment when anger prevails, and hastens to reward the good, taking the first possible opportunity to do so.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : أحْزَمُ النّاسِ أكْظَمُهُمْ للغَيْظِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The most prudent of people is he who is best at controlling his rage.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إنَّ أكْيَسَكُم أكْثَرُكُم ذِكْراً للمَوتِ ، وإنَّ أحْزَمَكُم أحْسَنُكُمُ اسْتِعْداداً لَهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The most sagacious one from among you is he who remembers death the most, and the most prudent one from among you is he who is the most prepared for it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أحْزَمُكُم أزْهَدُكُم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most prudent one from among you is the one who is most abstemious.

_source.arabic: عمرو بن يزيد: قال الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّه، أتَخَوَّفُ علَيكُم في البَرزَخِ ! قلتُ: وما البَرْزخُ ؟ قالَ: القَبرُ، مُنذُ حينِ مَوتِهِ إلى يومِ القيامةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘By Allah! I fear for you the barzakh! He was asked, ‘What is the barzakh? He replied, ‘The grave, from the day one dies until the Day of Judgment.

_source.chapter: The Souls of the Believers in the Purgatory
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أرواحُ المؤمنينَ في حُجُراتٍ في الجنّةِ، يأكُلونَ مِن طَعامِها، ويَشْرَبونَ مِن شَرابِها، ويَتَزاوَرونَ فيها، ويقولونَ: ربَّنا، أقِمْ لنا السّاعةَ لِتُنْجِزَ لنا ما وَعَدْتَنا.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The souls of the believers will be in chambers in Paradise, eating of its food and drinking its drinks, and visiting one another, saying, ‘Our Lord! Bring the Final Hour, so that You may fulfil what You promised us.

_source.chapter: The Souls of Disbelievers in the Purgatory
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ أرواحَ الكُفّارِ في نارِ جَهنّمَ يُعْرَضونَ علَيها يقولونَ: ربَّنا، لا تُقِمْ لنا السَّاعةَ، ولا تُنْجِزْ لنا ما وَعَدْتَنا، ولا تُلْحِقْ آخِرَنا بأوَّلِنا !
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The souls of disbelievers are in the Fire of Hell, exposed to it, saying, ‘Our Lord! Delay the Final Hour, and do not fulfil what You warned us against, nor make the last of us catch up with the first.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الطَّهُورُ شَطرُ الإيمانِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Purification is a portion of faith.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أوَّلُ مايُحاسَبُ بهِ العَبدُ طَهُورُهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The first thing that the servant will have to account for is his ritual purification.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تُقبَلُ صَلاةٌ بغَيرِ طَهورٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A prayer without ablution is not accepted.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خَلَقَ اللّهُ الماءَ طَهورا لا يُنَجِّسُهُ شَيءٌ، إلّا ما غَيَّرَ لَونَهُ أو طَعمَهُ أو رِيحَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah has created water to be a purifier where nothing can make it impure, except for that water whose colour, taste or smell has changed.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ ما أشرَقَت علَيهِ الشَّمسُ فهُو طاهِرٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Everything that the sun shines on becomes purified.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّهَ عَزَّوجلَّ جَعَلَ التُّرابَ طَهوراً كما جَعَلَ الماءَ طَهوراً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah, Mighty and Exalted, made the earth a purifier just as he made water a purifier.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لمّا سُئلَ عنِ الجِصِّ يُوقَدُ عَلَيهِ بِالعذَرَةِ وعِظامِ المَوتى ثُمَّ يُجَصَّصُ بِهِ المَسجِدُ ، أيُسجَدُ عَلَيهِ ؟ ـ: إنَّ الماءَ وَالنّارَ قَد طَهَّراهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) was once asked about gypsum that is burnt along with dried excrement and bone ash, and then used to plaster a mosque, and whether prostration on such plaster is allowed. He replied, ‘Verily water and fire [from the kilning process] have purified it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فَرَضَ اللّهُ الإيمانَ تَطهيراً مِن الشِّركِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah has obligated faith in order to purify one from polytheism.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ تَقوَى اللّهِ دَواءُ داءِ قُلوبِكُم ... وطَهُورُ دَنَسِ أنفُسِكُم .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily being wary of ones duty to Allah is the remedy for the disease of your hearts … and the purifier of the pollution in your souls.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إن كُنتُم لا مَحالَةَ مُتَطَهِّرِينَ فَتَطَهَّرُوا مِن دَنَسِ العُيوبِ والذُّنوبِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Since you have no choice but to purify your bodies, then make a point of purifying yourselves of your faults and your sins.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ الرجُلَ إذا سَقَى امرَأتَهُ الماءَ اُجِرَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If a man quenches his wife's thirst he is rewarded for it.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا كَثُرَت ذُنوبُكَ فاسْقِ الماءَ عَلَى الماءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If you have committed many sins, then quench peoples thirst time after time.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن سَقى مُؤمناً مِن ظَمَأٍ سَقاهُ اللّهُ مِنَ الرَّحيقِ المَختومِ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, 'Whoever quenches a believer of his thirst, Allah will quench him from the pure sealed wine [of Paradise].

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن سَقى ظَمآنا ماءً سَقاهُ اللّهُ مِنَ الرَّحيقِ المَختومِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ''Whoever gives a drink of water to a thirsty person, Allah will quench him from the pure sealed wine [of Paradise].

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ أوَّلَ ما يُبدَأُ بهِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ صَدَقةُ الماءِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Verily the first thing to be rewarded on the Day of Resurrection will be the giving of water.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of Quenching Someone's Thirst
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ الصَّدقَةِ إبرادُ الكَبِدِ الحَرّى ، ومَن سَقى كَبِدا حَرّى مِن بَهيمَةٍ أو غَيرِها أظَلَّهُ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ يَومَ لا ظِلَّ إلّا ظِلُّهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'The best form of charity is to cool down someone's internal heat [by quenching them], and whoever quenches an animal's or any other being's internal heat, Allah will shade him on the Day when no shade will avail except His shade.

_source.chapter: The Duty of One Who Quenches Others
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لِيَشرَبْ ساقِي القَومِ آخِرَهُم .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'The one who gives people to drink should himself drink last of all.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّما سُمِّيَ الرَّمَضانُ لأنّهُ يَرمَضُ الذُّنوبَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily Ramazan has been thus named because it scorches away sins.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ أبوابَ السماءِ تُفتَحُ في أوَّلِ ليلةٍ مِن شَهرِ رَمَضانَ، ولا تُغلَقُ إلى آخِرِ ليلةٍ مِنهُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily the gates of the heavens are opened on the first night of the month of Ramazan, and are not closed again until the very last night.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَو يَعلَمُ العَبدُ ما في رَمَضانَ لَوَدَّ أن يكونَ رَمَضانُ السَّنَةَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If the servant was to fathom the worth of Ramazan, he would wish that Ramazan lasted the whole year.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا استَهَلَّ رَمَضانُ غُلِّقَتْ أبوابُ النارِ ، وفُتِحَتْ أبوابُ الجِنانِ ، وصُفِّدَتِ الشَّياطينُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'As soon as the month of Ramazan sets in, the gates of Hell are locked up, the gates of Paradise are opened, and the devils are bound up.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) خَطَبَنا ذاتَ يَومٍ، فقالَ: أيُّها الناسُ ، إنّهُ قد أقبَلَ إلَيكُم شَهرُ اللّهِ بالبَرَكَةِ والرّحمَةِ والمَغفِرةِ ، شَهرٌ هُو عِندَ اللّهِ أفضَلُ الشُّهورِ ، وأيّامُهُ أفضَلُ الأيّامِ ، ولَيالِيهِ أفضَلُ اللَّيالِي ، وساعاتُهُ أفضَلُ الساعاتِ ، هُو شَهرٌ دُعِيتُمْ فيهِ إلى ضِيافَةِ اللّهِ وجُعِلتُم فيهِ مِن أهلِ كَرامَةِ اللّهِ ، أنفاسُكُم فيهِ تَسبيحٌ ، ونَومُكُم فيهِ عِبادَةٌ ، وعَمَلُكُم فيهِ مَقبولٌ ، ودُعاؤكُم فيهِ مُستَجابٌ ... فَقُمتُ فقلتُ: يا رسولَ اللّهِ ، ما أفضَلُ الأعمالِ في هذا الشَّهرِ؟ فقالَ: يا أبا الحسنِ، أفضَلُ الأعمالِ في هذا الشَّهرِ، الوَرَعُ عن مَحارِمِ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Verily the Prophet of Allah (AS) addressed us one day, saying, "O people, verily the month of Allah has come to you with benediction, mercy and forgiveness - a month that is the best of months in the sight of Allah, whose days are the best of days, whose nights are the best of nights, and whose hours are the best of hours. It is a month wherein you have been invited to the banquet of Allah and have been made worthy of Allah's magnanimity. Your breaths during this month are considered glorification [of Allah], and your sleep worship. Your actions in it are accepted and your supplication answered…" Upon hearing this, I stood up and asked, 'O Prophet of Allah, what is the best of deeds to be performed in this month?' He replied, 'O Abu al-Hasan, the best of deeds in this month is to restrain oneself from all that Allah, Mighty and Exalted, has prohibited.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقر (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) لَمّا حَضَرَ شَهرُ رَمَضانَ وذلكَ لثَلاثٍ بَقِينَ مِن شَعبانَ، قالَ لبِلالٍ: نادِ في الناسِ ، فَجَمعَ الناسُ ثُمّ صَعِدَ المِنبَرَ، فَحَمِدَ اللّهَ وأثنى علَيهِ، ثُمّ قالَ: أيُّها الناسَ ، إنَّ هذا الشَّهرَ قد حَضَرَكُم وهُو سَيِّدُ الشُّهُورِ ، فيهِ ليلةٌ خَيرٌ مِن ألفِ شَهرٍ ، تُغلَقُ فيهِ أبوابُ النِّيرانِ، وتُفتَحُ فيهِ أبوابُ الجِنانِ ، فَمَن أدرَكَهُ فلَم يُغفَرْ لهُ فَأبعَدَهُ اللّهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrated, 'At the end of Shaaban, when there were only three days left till the month of Ramazan, the Prophet (SAWA) told Bilal, 'Call all the people', so the people gathered together. The Prophet (SAWA) mounted the pulpit, praised Allah and glorified Him, then continued, 'O people, this month that is coming upon you is the chief of all months. One particular night in it is better than a thousand months. During this month, the gates of Hell are locked up, and the gates of Paradise are opened. So whoever, in spite of experiencing this month is not forgiven, has indeed been distanced by Allah.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِن وَصِيَّتِهِ لِولْدِهِ عِندَ دُخُولِ شَهرِ رَمَضانَ ـ: فاجهَدُوا أنفُسَكُم فإنّ فيهِ تُقسَمُ الأرزاقُ ، وتُكتَبُ الآجالُ ، وفيهِ يُكتَبُ وَفدُ اللّهِ الذين يَفِدُونَ إلَيهِ ، وفيهِ ليلةٌ العَمَلُ فيها خَيرٌ مِن العَمَلِ في ألفِ شَهرٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), in his advice to his children heralding the advent of the month of Ramazan, said, 'Exert yourselves [in doing good deeds] for verily in this month sustenance is apportioned, life spans are destined, the names of Allah's select servants who wish to strive towards Him are recorded down, and in this month is a night wherein the good deeds performed equal the deeds of a thousand months.

_source.chapter: Allah's Forgiveness in the Month of Ramazan
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أدرَكَ شَهرَ رَمَضانَ فلَم يُغفَرْ لَهُ فَأبعَدَهُ اللّهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who experiences the month of Ramazan and remains unforgiven has indeed been distanced by Allah.

_source.chapter: Allah's Forgiveness in the Month of Ramazan
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ في خُطبتِهِ عندَ إقبالِ شهرِ رمضانَ ـ إنّ الشَّقِيَّ مَن حُرِمَ غُفرانَ اللّهِ في هذا الشَّهرِ العَظيمِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA), in his sermon heralding the advent of the month of Ramazan, said, 'Verily the most unfortunate is he who is deprived of Allah's forgiveness in this great month.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:1, p. 295, number:53

_source.chapter: Allah's Forgiveness in the Month of Ramazan
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَنْ لم يُغفَرْ لَهُ في شَهرِ رمضانَ ففِي أيِّ شهرٍ يُغفَرُ لَهُ ؟!
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If a person remains unforgiven in the month of Ramazan, then what other month is there left for him to be forgiven in?!'

_source.chapter: Allah's Forgiveness in the Month of Ramazan
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لَم يُغفَرْ لَهُ في شهرِ رمضانَ لَم يُغفَرْ لَهُ إلى مِثلِهِ مِن قابِلٍ إلّا أن يَشهَدَ عَرَفَةَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'If a person remains unforgiven in the month of Ramazan, he will not be forgiven in any other month after it unless he is able to attend the plains of AArafa [during the obligatory pilgrimage].

_source.arabic: عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا عَبيدَ الدنيا، تَحلِقُونَ رُؤوسَكُم وتُقَصِّرُونَ قُمُصَكُم وتُنَكِّسونَ رُؤوسَكُم ولا تَنزِعونَ الغِلَّ مِن قُلوبِكُم؟!
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘O slaves of this world, you shave your heads [claiming to be ascetics], you shorten your shirts, you bow your heads but do not remove the rancour from your hearts?!

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا لم تَغُلَّ اُمَّتي لم يَقُمْ لَها عَدُوٌّ أبَداً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘If it was not for the rancour that my community harbours, no enemy would ever challenge it.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الغِلُّ بَذْرُ الشَّرِّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Rancour is the seed of evil.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الغِلُّ يُحبِطُ الحَسَناتِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Rancour thwarts good deeds.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أشَدُّ القُلوبِ غِلاًّ قَلبُ الحَقُودِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The heart that harbours the most rancour is the heart of the malicious person.

_source.chapter: That Which the Heart Cannot Harbour Rancour Towards
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) :ثلاثٌ لايَغُلُّ علَيهِنَّ قلبُ امرئٍ مسلمٍ: إخلاصُ العَمَلِ للّهِ، ومُناصَحَةُ وُلاةِ الأمرِ، ولزومُ جَماعَةِ المُسلمينَ ؛ فإنَّ دَعوَتَهُم تُحيطُ مِن وَراءِهِم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There are three things towards which the heart of a Muslim will not harbour rancour: the sincere act performed for Allah, the sincere advice of leaders, and adherence to the community of Muslims; for verily their attraction towards these things encompasses them from all sides.

_source.chapter: The One Who Breaches His Trust (out of Rancour)
_source.arabic: الدرّ المنثور عن ابنِ عبّاسٍ: نَزَلَت هذهِ الآيةُ: «وما كانَ لِنبيٍّ أنْ يَغُلَّ» في قَطيفَةٍ حَمراءَ افتُقِدَتْ يَومَ بَدرٍ، فقالَ بعضُ الناسِ: لَعَلَّ رسولَ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) أخَذَها! فَأنزَلَ اللهِ: «وما كانَ لِنبيٍّ أن يَغُلَّ».
_source.english: Ibn Aabbas narrated, ‘The verse: “A prophet may not breach his trust, and whoever breaches his trust will bring his breaches on the Day of Resurrection” was revealed with regards to a red velvet shawl that got lost on the day of the battle of Badr, so some people started saying that maybe the Prophet (SAWA) had taken it! So Allah revealed the verse: “A prophet may not breach his trust …”

_source.chapter: The One Who Breaches His Trust (out of Rancour)
_source.arabic: الترغيب والترهيب: لَمّا كانَ يومُ خَيبَرَ أقبَلَ نَفَرٌ مِن أصحابِ النبيِّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) فقالوا: فلانٌ شَهيدٌ، وفلانٌ شَهيدٌ، وفلانٌ شهيدٌ، حتّى مَرُّوا على رَجُلٍ فقالوا: فلانٌ شَهيدٌ، فقالَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كَلاّ، إنّي رَأيتُهُ فِي النارِ في بُردَةٍ غَلَّها، أو عَباءَةٍ غَلَّها.
_source.english: Aumar narrated, ‘On the day of the battle of Khaybar, some of the Prophet (SAWA)s companions came to him, [listing who had been martyred], ‘x is a martyr, y is a martyr, etc… until they mentioned a particular man as having been martyred, upon which the Prophet (SAWA) exclaimed, ‘No way, verily I have seen him burning in the Fire, clad in a shawl or a cloak that he had taken [as a breach of trust of the war booty].
_source.cited_from: Al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, volume:2, p. 307, number:4

_source.chapter: The One Who Breaches His Trust (out of Rancour)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الغُلولُ كُلُّ شيءٍ غُلَّ عن الإمامِ، وأكلُ مالِ اليَتيمِ شُبهَةً، والسُّحْتُ شُبهَةً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Breach of trust includes anything that is taken unlawfully from ones Imam [in the form of war booty before it has been justly divided], or usurping the property of an orphan, or consuming illicit gains.

_source.chapter: The Person with the Greatest Regret
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إنَّ أشَدَّ النّاسِ نَدامَةً يَومَ القِيامَةِ ، رجُلٌ باعَ آخِرَتَهُ بدُنيا غَيرِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The person with the most intense remorse on the Day of Resurrection will be the man who sold his Hereafter for the world of others.

_source.chapter: The Person with the Greatest Regret
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ أعْظَمَ الحَسَراتِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ ، حَسْرَةُ رجُلٍ كَسَبَ مالاً في غَيرِ طاعَةِ اللّهِ ، فوَرِثَهُ رجُلٌ فأنْفَقَهُ في طاعةِ اللّهِ سُبحانَهُ ، فدَخَلَ بهِ الجَنّةَ ، ودَخَلَ الأوَّلُ بهِ النّارَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The greatest of regrets on the Day of Resurrection will be the regret of a man who gained wealth through means of disobedience Allah, which was then inherited by a man who spent it in the obedience of Allah, glory be to Him; thus because of it [i.e. the same wealth] the latter entered Paradise whereas the former entered the Fire.

_source.chapter: The Person with the Greatest Regret
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّ أعظَمَ النّاسِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ (حَسْرَةً) مَن وَصفَ عَدْلاً ثُمَّ خالَفَهُ إلى غَيرِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The most regretful person on the Day of Resurrection will be the man who speaks of justice yet acts in opposition to it with others.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن دَقَّ في الدِّينِ نَظَرُهُ جَلَّ يومَ القِيامَةِ خَطَرُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever gives acute attention to their religion will have a lofty station on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدِّينُ نورٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Religion is light.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدِّينُ يَعصِمُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Religion immunizes.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدِّينُ أقوَى عِمادٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Religion is the strongest support.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ أميرُ المؤمنينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) كثيراً مّا يقولُ في خُطبتِهِ: يا أيّها الناسُ ، دِينَكُم دِينَكم !! فإنّ السيّئةَ فيهِ خيرٌ مِن الحَسَنةِ في غَيرِهِ ، والسيّئةَ فيهِ تُغفَرُ ، والحَسَنةَ في غيرِهِ لا تُقبَلُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The Commander of the Faithful (AS) would frequently say in his sermons, ‘O people! Preserve your religion, for the bad deed of a religious person is better than the good deed of a religion-less person, because the bad deed of a religious person can be forgiven but the good deed of a religion-less person is not even accepted.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): آفَةُ الدِّينِ سُوءُ الظنِّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The bane of religion is suspiciousness.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فسادُ الدِّينِ الدنيا.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The corruption of religion lies in [the vanities of] this world.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): آفَةُ الدِّينِ: الحَسَدُ والعُجبُ والفَخرُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The bane of religion is in jealousy, self-conceit and pride.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا حَضَرَت بَلِيَّةٌ فاجعَلُوا أموالَكُم دونَ أنفسِكُم ، وإذا نَزَلَت نازلةٌ فاجعَلُوا أنفسَكُم دونَ دِينِكُم ، واعلَمُوا أنَّ الهالِكَ مَن هَلَكَ دِينُهُ ، والحَريبَ مَن حُرِبَ دِينُهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘If you are faced with a tribulation, shield your life with your wealth. If you are faced with a calamity, then shield your religion with your life, and know that the ruined man is he who destroys his religion himself and that the corrupted one is he who spoils his religion himself.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ كانَ يقولُ عندَ المُصيبةِ ـ: الحمدُ للّهِ الذي لم يَجعَلْ مُصِيبَتِي في دِينِي.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) would say when struck with an affliction, ‘All praise be to Allah who did not allow my religion to be afflicted.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا دِينَ لِمَن دانَ بطاعةِ مَن عَصَى اللّهَ ، ولا دِينَ لِمَن دانَ بِفِريَةِ باطلٍ على اللّهِ ، ولا دِينَ لِمَن دانَ بجُحُودِ شَيءٍ مِن آياتِ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘One who subjects himself to the obedience of someone who disobeys Allah has no religion, and the one who subjects himself to attributing a lie or falsity to Allah has no religion, and the one who subjects himself to denying any of Allahs signs has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا دِينَ لِمَن دانَ بولايةِ إمامٍ جائرٍ لَيسَ مِنَ اللّهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who subjects himself to following an oppressive leader unendorsed by Allah has no religin.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لادِينَ لِمَن لاعَهدَ لَه .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who has no covenant has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كُلُّ مَن لم يُحِبَّ على الدِّينِ ولم يُبغِضْ على الدِّينِ فلا دينَ لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Anyone whose love and hate is not based on religion, has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا دِينَ لِمَن لامُرُوَّةَ لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘He who has no valorous qualities has no religion.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لادِينَ لِمَن لاوَرَعَ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘He who has no piety has no religion.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يا أيّها الناسُ ، إنَّ دِينَ اللّهِ يُسرٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘O people, verily the religion of Allah is easy.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): بُعِثتُ بِالحَنِيفِيَّةِ السَّمْحَةِ ، ومَن خالَفَ سُنَّتِي فلَيسَ مِنّي.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I have been sent [to you] with the upright and liberal religion and whoever defies my prophetic practice is not from me.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ اللّهَ لم يَبعَثْنِي بالرَّهبانِيَّةِ ، وإنّ خيرَ الدِينِ عندَ اللّهِ الحنيفيّةُ السَّمْحَةُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily Allah has not sent me with monasticism, rather the best religion with Allah is the upright and liberal one.

_source.chapter: The Only Religion Through Which Deeds are Accepted
_source.arabic: عن عليِّ بنِ أبي حمزَةَ عن أبي بصيرٍ، قال: سمعتُهُ يسألُ أبا عبدِ اللّهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) فقالَ له: جُعِلتُ فِداكَ أخبِرْني عنِ الدِّينِ الذي افتَرَضَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ عَلى العبادِ ما لا يَسَعُهُم جَهلُهُ ، ولا يُقبَلُ مِنهُم غيرُهُ ماهو ؟ فقالَ: شهادةُ أن لا إلهَ إلّا اللّهُ ، وأنّ محمّداً رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ، وإقامُ الصلاةِ ، وإيتاءُ الزكاةِ ، وحجُّ البيتِ مَنِ استَطاعَ إلَيهِ سبيلاً ، وصومُ شَهرِ رمضانَ . ثُمّ سَكَتَ قليلاً ثُمّ قالَ: والوَلايةُ ـ مَرّتَينِ ـ .
_source.english: Abu Basir asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS), ‘May I be your ransom! Please inform me about the religion that Allah has obligated upon his servants, [the religion] that they cannot afford to be ignorant of and the only religion that will be accepted from them. What is it? The Imam (AS) replied, ‘Bearing witness that there is no god except Allah and that Muhammad (SAWA) is the messenger of Allah, establishing the prayer, paying the alms-tax, pilgrimage to the House for those who are able to do so, fasting the month of Ramadhan. Then the Imam momentarily paused and then repeated twice, ‘and divine guardianship [of the divinely appointed Imams] (al-walaya).
_source.chapter_ar: الدِّينُ الَّذي لا تُقبَلُ الأعمالُ إلّا بِهِ

_source.chapter: The Correct Way to Understanding Religion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن عَرَفَ دينَهُ مِن كتابِ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ زالَتِ الجِبالُ قبلَ أن يَزُولَ ، ومَن دَخَلَ في أمرٍ بِجَهلٍ خَرَجَ منهُ بِجَهلٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who understands his religion from the Book of Allah, mountains will move before he does [in his faith], and the one who enters a matter with ignorance [i.e. accepts religion ignorantly] will leave it in ignorance.

_source.chapter: The Correct Way to Understanding Religion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن دَخَلَ في هذا الدِّينِ بالرِّجالِ أخرَجَهُ مِنهُ الرِّجالُ كما أدخَلُوهُ فيهِ ، ومَن دَخَلَ فيهِ بِالكِتابِ والسُّنَّةِ زالَتِ الجبالُ قَبلَ أن يَزولَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who enters this religion through men will exit it through men just as they caused him to enter it. And whoever enters this religion through the Book and the prophetic practice, mountains will move before he does [in his faith].

_source.chapter: Protecting the Religion By Means of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صُن دِينَكَ بدُنياكَ تَربَحْهُما ، ولا تَصُنْ دنياكَ بِدِينِكَ فَتَخسَرَهُما.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Protect your religion by means of your worldly affairs and you will profit in both, but do not use your religion to protect your worldly affairs as you will lose them both.

_source.chapter: Protecting the Religion By Means of the World
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَترُكُ الناسُ شيئاً مِن دِينِهِم لِإصلاحِ دُنياهُم إلّا فَتَحَ اللّهُ عَليهِم ما هُوَ أضَرُّ مِنهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘No sooner do people omit any aspect of their religion for the sake of improving their worldly affairs than Allah will open for them something that will be more detrimental to them [than the improvement of their worldly affairs].

_source.chapter: Supplication for Affirming the Heart towards Religion
_source.arabic: عن عبد اللّه بن سنان: قال أبو عبد اللّه (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سَتُصيبُكُم شُبهَةٌ فَتَبقُونَ بِلا عَلَمٍ يُرى ولا إمامٍ هدى ، ولا يَنجُو مِنها إلّا مَن دَعا بدُعاءِ الغَريقِ. قلتُ: كيفَ دعاءُ الغَريقِ ؟ قالَ: يقولُ: «يا اللّهُ يا رحمنُ يا رحيمُ يا مُقَلِّبَ القُلوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلبِي على دِينِكَ» .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘You will be afflicted with an obscure matter that will leave you with no sign to indicate to the solution, nor a leader to guide the way. None shall be saved from it except the one who recites the ‘Supplication of the Drowning Person. [The narrator says] I asked the Imam, ‘What is the Supplication of the Drowning Person? The Imam replied, ‘O Allah, O the Beneficent, O the Merciful, O He who causes the hearts to fluctuate, affirm my heart upon Your religion.

_source.chapter: Characteristics of the Preservers of Allahs Religion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّما المُستَحفِظُونَ لِدِينِ اللّهِ هُمُ الذينَ أقامُوا الدِّينَ ونَصَرُوهُ ، وحاطُوهُ مِن جميعِ جَوانِبِهِ ، وحَفِظُوهُ على عِبادِ اللّهِ ورَعَوهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the preservers of Allahs religion are the same people who established the religion and helped it, they guarded it from all sides, they preserved it for the servants of Allah and carefully watched over it.

_source.chapter: The Strengthening of Religion through a Disgraceful People
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ اللّهَ لَيُؤَيِّدُ هذا الدِّينَ بالرَّجُلِ الفاجِرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily Allah strengthens this religion through an oppressive man.
_source.chapter_ar: تَأييدُ الدِّينِ بِأقوامٍ لا خَلاقَ لَهُم

_source.chapter: The Strengthening of Religion through a Disgraceful People
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ اللّهَ تَبارَكَ وَتَعالى يُؤَيِّدُ هذا الدِّينَ بِأقوامٍ لا خَلاَقَ لَهُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily Allah, Blessed and most High, strengthens this religion through a disgraceful people.
_source.chapter_ar: تَأييدُ الدِّينِ بِأقوامٍ لا خَلاقَ لَهُم

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ نبيّاً مِنَ الأنبياءِ مَرِضَ، فقالَ: لا أتَداوى حتّى يكونَ الذي أمرَضَنِي هُو الذي يَشفينِي ، فأوحَى اللّهُ تعالى إلَيهِ: لا أشفِيكَ حتّى تَتَداوى، فإنَّ الشِّفاءَ مِنّي.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘A prophet from among the prophets fell sick and said, ‘I will not treat myself [with medicine] until the One who made me sick heals me. Then Allah revealed to him saying, ‘I will not heal you until you treat yourself [with medicine] for verily the healing is from Me.

_source.chapter: There is a Cure for Every Ailment
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَداوَوا فإنَّ اللّهَ تعالى لَم يُنزِلْ داءً إلّا وقد أنزَلَ اللّهُ لَهُ شِفاءً ، إلّا السّامَ والهَرَمَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Treat yourselves with medicine, for verily Allah has not sent down any ailment except that he has sent down a cure for it with the exception of death and old age.

_source.chapter: There is a Cure for Every Ailment
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لِكُلِّ عِلّةٍ دَواءٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘For every ailment, there is a cure.

_source.chapter: Beware of Hastening towards Resorting to Medicine
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَجَنَّبِ الدَّواءَ ما احتَمَلَ بَدنُكَ الداءَ ، فإذا لم يَحتَمِلِ الداءَ فالدواءُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Avoid medicine as long as your body can bear the ailment, but if it cannot bear the ailment, then resort to medicine.

_source.chapter: Beware of Hastening towards Resorting to Medicine
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَتَداوَى المُسلمُ حتّى يَغلِبَ مَرَضُهُ صِحَّتَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A Muslim does not seek to treat himself [with medicine] until the ailment overcomes his health.

_source.chapter: Beware of Hastening towards Resorting to Medicine
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَيسَ مِن دواءٍ إلّا وهو يُهَيِّجُ داءً، وليسَ شيءٌ في البَدنِ أنفَعَ مِن إمساكِ اليدِ إلّا عمّا يَحتاجُ إلَيهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘There is no medicine except that it exacerbates another ailment, and there is nothing more beneficial to the body than self-restraint from all except that which the body needs.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التَّجوُّعُ أنفَعُ الدواءِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Starving out is the best of remedies.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَضُرُّ المَريضَ ما حَمَيتَ عنهُ الطَّعامَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Dieting from food causes no harm to the sick person.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَنفَعُ الحِميَةُ لمريضٍ بعدَ سبعَةِ أيّامٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘[Starting to] Diet from food is of no benefit to the sick person after seven days.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الحِميةُ رأسُ الدواءِ ، والمَعِدةُ بيتُ الداءِ ، عَوِّدْ بَدَناً ما تَعَوّدَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Diet control is the fountainhead of remedies and the stomach is the house of all ailments, so condition your body while it can be conditioned.

_source.chapter: Diet Control is the Fountainhead of Remedies
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَيسَ الحِميةُ أن تَدَعَ الشيءَ أصلاً لاتَأكُلَهُ، ولكنَّ الحِميَةَ أن تَأكُلَ مِنَ الشيءِ وتُخَفِّفَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Diet control is not to avoid eating absolutely anything, rather diet control is to eat lightly.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): في طِينِ قبرِ الحسينِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) الشِّفاءُ مِن كلِّ داءٍ وهُوَ الدواءُ الأكبَرُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘In the soil of the grave of Husayn (AS) is a healing for every disease, for it is the greatest remedy.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ربّما كانَ الدَّواءُ داءً والدّاءُ دواءً .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘It is possible for a medicine to be an ailment and an ailment to be a medicine.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَصِفَنَّ لِمَلِكٍ دواءً ، فإن نَفَعَهُ لَم يَحمَدْكَ ، وإن ضَرَّهُ اتَّهَمَكَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘Do not prescribe any remedy for a king, for if it benefits him, he will fail to show gratitude to you, and if it harms him he will accuse you.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَختارَنَّ عَلى ذِكرِ اللّهِ شَيئاً فإنّهُ يقولُ: «وَلَذِكْرُ اللّهِ أكْبَرُ».
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Never prefer anything above the remembrance of Allah for verily He says, “and the remembrance of Allah is surely greater.”

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: عن معاذ عنه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَيسَ عَمَلٌ أحَبَّ إلى اللّهِ تعالى ولا أنجى لِعَبدٍ مِن كُلِّ سيّئةٍ في الدنيا والآخِرَةِ مِن ذِكرِ اللّهِ . قيلَ: ولا القتالُ في سبيلِ اللّهِ ؟ قالَ: لولا ذِكرُ اللّهِ لم يُؤمَرْ بالقِتالِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There is no action more beloved to Allah Almighty, or more successful as a means of salvation for a servant of Allah from all the evil of this world and the next than the remembrance of Allah. Someone then asked, ‘Not even fighting in the way of Allah? The Prophet (SAWA) replied, ‘If it was not for the remembrance of Allah, there would be no command to fight in the way of Allah.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الذِّكرُ لَذَّةُ المُحِبِّينَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remembrance is a source of great pleasure for the lovers [of Allah].

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الذِّكرُ مُجالَسَةُ المَحبوبِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remembrance is sitting in the company of the Beloved One.

_source.chapter: The Virtue of the Remembrance of Allah
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ذِكرُ اللّهِ سَجِيَّةُ كُلِّ مُحسِنٍ وشِيمَةُ كُلِّ مُؤمنٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Remembrance of Allah is the natural disposition of every good-doer and the distinguishing mark of every believer.

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): عَليكَ بتِلاوَةِ القرآنِ وذِكرِ اللّهِ كثيراً ، فإنّهُ ذِكرٌ لكَ في السماءِ ونورٌ لكَ في الأرضِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I urge you to recite the Quran and remember Allah frequently, for verily it [will result in] a remembrance for you in the heavens and a light for you in the earth.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن ذَكَرَ اللّهَ في السِرِّ فقد ذَكَرَ اللّهَ كثيراً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Whoever remembers Allah in private, has surely remembered Allah much.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أكثِرُوا ذِكرَ اللّهِ ما استَطَعتُم في كُلِّ ساعةٍ مِن ساعاتِ الليلِ والنهارِ ، فإنَّ اللّهَ أمَرَ بكَثرَةِ الذِكرِ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Remember Allah frequently as much as you can every hour of the day and night, for verily Allah has commanded [us] to remember Him abundantly.

_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَسبيحُ فاطمةَ الزهراءِ (عَلَيهَا الّسَلامُ) مِنَ الذِكرِ الكثيرِ الذي قالَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ: «اُذْكُرُوا اللّهَ ذِكْراً كثيراً» .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The glorification of Fatima al-Zahra [The glorification of Fatima al-Zahra (AS), otherwise known as Tasbih al-Zahra is composed of reciting Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greater) 34 times, Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah) 33 times and Subhanallah (Glory be to Allah) 33 times. Usually it is recommended to recite it after every obligatory prayer (ed.)] (AS) is from the frequent remembrance which Allah mentions, “Remember Allah with a frequent remembrance.”

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Engaging in Continuous Remembrance
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ما مِن ساعةٍ تَمُرُّ بابنِ آدَمَ لَم يَذكُرِ اللّهَ فيها إلّا حَسِرَ علَيها يَومَ القيامَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Every single hour that passes by the son of Adam, that was devoid of the remembrance of Allah will be grieved for on the Day of Resurrection.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Engaging in Continuous Remembrance
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في المُناجاةِ الشَّعبانيّةِ ـ: إلهي، وألْهِمني وَلَهاً بِذِكرِكَ إلى ذِكرِكَ وهِمَّتي إلى روحِ نَجاحِ أسمائكَ ومَحَلِّ قُدسِكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in the intimate supplication of the month of Shaban (Al-Munajat al-Shaabaniyya: the intimate supplication of the month of Shaaban recited by Imam Ali (AS) and the Imams from his progeny (AS) during the sacred month of Shaaban), ‘My God! Inspire me with fervour for Your remembrance until I have become inspired with Your remembrance, and a spiritual zeal for the refreshing salvation of Your Names and the place of Your sanctity.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Engaging in Continuous Remembrance
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أسأَلُكَ أن تُصَلِّيَ على محمّدٍ وآلِ محمّدٍ ، وأن تَجعَلَنِي مِمَّن يُدِيمُ ذِكرَكَ ، ولا يَنقُضُ عَهدَكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘I ask You to send blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to make me of those who are continuous in Your remembrance and who do not breach Your covenant.

_source.chapter: The Remembrance of Allah is Good at All Times
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ مِن وَصاياهُ لاِبنِهِ الحسنِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) عِندَ الوَفاةِ ـ: وكُن للّهِ ذاكِراً على كلِّ حالٍ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in counsel to his son Hasan at the time of his death (AS), ‘and be one to remember Allah at all times.
_source.chapter_ar: ذِكرُ اللّهِ حَسَنٌ عَلى كُلِّ حالٍ

_source.chapter: The Remembrance of Allah is Good at All Times
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ موسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا ربِّ ، إنّي أكونُ في حالٍ اُجِلُّكَ أن أذكُرَكَ فيها . قالَ: يا موسى ، اُذكُرْني على كُلِّ حالٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, ‘Prophet Moses (AS) said, ‘My Lord, I am in a [base] state wherin I esteem You too highly to remember You therein, He said, ‘O Moses, remember Me at all times.
_source.chapter_ar: ذِكرُ اللّهِ حَسَنٌ عَلى كُلِّ حالٍ

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الذاكِرُ في الغافِلينَ كالمُقاتِلِ في الفارِّينَ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The one who remembers [Allah] in the midst of the neglectful ones is as one who fights [in the way of Allah] in the midst of others who flee [from the battle].

_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): كُلُّ أحَدٍ يَموتُ عَطْشانَ إلّا ذاكِرَ اللّهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Everyone will die thirsty except the one who remembers Allah.
